summary: Native conversation headers retain assistant usage, model and context when a large message crosses the newest-first header window boundary; message-level metadata is counted once on the last projected block.

replay.detail: Accounting is derived from owner-native conversation reads; no claim replay or projection rebuild is added.

schema.detail: No database or client schema fields change. Message-level values remain in the existing block metadata field.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: The existing header and block metadata shapes are unchanged. Moving the single metadata owner to the last projected block preserves accounting in bounded newest-first windows without changing normal renderer labels.

downtime.detail: No migration wait or coordinated outage is introduced.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual migration is required.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes; conversation content and derived metadata remain memory-only.
